compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD6: shared thread-reply posting function with is_inline-aware endpoint routing, used by all action handlers
- DD2: root_comment_id for any reply comment is the true thread root (walked to null), terminates on malformed/circular references (max-depth guard)

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh containing three exported functions:

### 1. probe_mcp_server
```
probe_mcp_server() → exits 0 if GitHub MCP tool responds; non-zero if 401/403/tool-not-found/timeout
```
- Attempt a lightweight MCP tool call (e.g., list_pull_requests with limit=1)
- On any failure (including timeout >5s), return non-zero
- Implemented as a reusable function callable by both pr-comment-response.sh and the standalone skill

### 2. resolve_root_comment_id
```
resolve_root_comment_id(comment_id, comments_json_array) → root_comment_id string
```
- Walk in_reply_to_id chain using jq on the comments array
- Return the comment itself if in_reply_to_id is null
- Max-depth guard: 50 iterations; if exceeded, return the last resolved ID and log warning
- Guard against cycles with a visited-set (bash associative array)

### 3. post_thread_reply
```
post_thread_reply(pr_number, root_comment_id, body, is_inline) → exit 0 on success
```
- is_inline=true: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number}/comments/{root_comment_id}/replies
- is_inline=false: POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{pr_number}/comments (body appended to thread)
- Uses gh api with GITHUB_TOKEN (never emit token in output/debug)
- On rate-limit (HTTP 403/429 with retry-after): detect and backoff/retry (max 3 attempts, exponential backoff)

## Security
- GITHUB_TOKEN must never appear in script output, debug messages, or error traces (A02:2021)
- Scrub token from any error message before emitting

## File placement
plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh (follows existing scripts/lib/ pattern, e.g., ci-findings-normalize.sh)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh exists and is executable (chmod +x required)
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh
- [ ] File exports probe_mcp_server, resolve_root_comment_id, and post_thread_reply functions
  Verify: bash -c 'source $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh && declare -f probe_mcp_server resolve_root_comment_id post_thread_reply' | grep -q "probe_mcp_server"
- [ ] resolve_root_comment_id returns self when in_reply_to_id is null
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "PASS.*chain_walk\|test_resolve_root.*PASS"
- [ ] post_thread_reply routes to pulls endpoint when is_inline=true, issues endpoint when is_inline=false
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "PASS.*reply_routing\|test_post_thread.*PASS"
- [ ] probe_mcp_server exits 0 on success, non-zero on tool-not-found
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "PASS.*mcp\|test_probe_mcp.*PASS"
- [ ] Unit tests in tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh all pass
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-pr-comment-lib.sh
- [ ] GITHUB_TOKEN does not appear in any script output (security check)
  Verify: GITHUB_TOKEN=FAKE_SENTINEL_12345 bash -c 'source $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/lib/pr-comment-lib.sh && probe_mcp_server 42 2>&1 || true' | grep -v "FAKE_SENTINEL_12345"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)

If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
